opening.argument: The presentation promotes short-duration directional trades and advertises returns of 70% to 400%. The founder explains that users can structure long or short trades, set an expiry and choose their risk, then invites listeners to try the demo account. The promoted DeFi Boost wallet connects token deposits with trading in underlying markets and offers an instant 80% payout when a prediction is correct. Although the speaker acknowledges that users can choose how much to lose when a trade fails, that caveat sits alongside prominent return claims and a direct invitation to try the platform. The presentation therefore promotes a trading product through high-return claims and rapid payouts, while acknowledging the possibility of loss.
